app.title: PDF Insight
app.tagline: Upload a PDF and get a summary and structured data as JSON.
upload.dropHint: Drag and drop a PDF file here
upload.privacyNotice: The document text (and images of pages without a text layer) will be sent to an AI API for analysis. Do not upload documents you are not allowed to share.
progress.extracting: Reading text from the PDF file…
progress.hint: This usually takes up to 30 seconds.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.invalid_file: This is not a valid PDF file, or it contains no readable text.
error.too_large: The file is too large. The maximum size is 10 MB.
error.extraction_failed: The PDF file could not be read. It may be damaged or encrypted.
error.network: Cannot reach the analysis server. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
error.payload_too_large: The document is too large to send. Try a shorter file.
error.origin_forbidden: This site is not allowed to use the analysis server.
error.invalid_request: The server rejected the request. Try again.
error.analysis_failed: The AI model did not return a valid answer. Try again.
error.upstream_error: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
error.invalid_response: The server response failed validation. Try again.
result.title: Title
json.title: JSON
json.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it manually.
meta.title: Analysis details
history.title: Recent analyses
history.empty: No saved analyses yet. Results are stored only in this browser.
footer.note: Documents are processed by an external AI API and are not stored on the server.
